column1: What role does the Python 'Interpreter' play during code execution?

column1: Define 'Bytecode' in the context of Python execution.
column2: An intermediate, internal language format that Python converts human-readable code into before running.

column1: How can you 'modify' a string if they are immutable?
column2: By creating a new string that combines parts of the old one with new characters.

column2: Lists use square brackets `[ ]` while Tuples use parentheses `( )`.

column2: Lists are mutable (can be changed); Tuples are immutable (cannot be changed).

column1: Under what circumstances should a Tuple be used instead of a List?
